dedupe_keys.name: energy and water statistics in abu dhabi 2016 production exports and available power bayanat open data

description: The Statistics Centre - Abu Dhabi publishes on the Bayanat UAE open data portal a table of energy and water statistics of the emirate for 2016. The dataset page read on 2026-09-28 describes it as detailed statistics on energy and water consumption in Abu Dhabi for 2016 and shows the first rows in its data explorer, for example annual crude oil production of 1,104,827 thousand barrels, crude exports of 885,474 thousand barrels, natural gas production of 2,272,711 million cubic feet, liquefied gas product exports of 26,733 thousand tonnes and 68,183,363 MWh of available electric power; further rows cover water. Coverage is the Emirate of Abu Dhabi for one year. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): CC-BY-4.0 (Bayanat copyright and data licensing page). Caveats: it is a single-year snapshot that looks unmaintained, and indicator definitions come from SCAD publications not linked on the page. It supports capacity planning context for Gulf energy and desalinated water systems, such as scaling supply and demand in a model of the emirate. Related record: the UAE housing units by water and electricity source give the household side of the same systems.
